extractedSnippet: Spring Cleanup Spring Cleanup Spring Cleanup is provided at no charge by the City and County of Broomfield and gives residents an opportunity to dispose of large, non-hazardous items that trash haulers do not normally pick up. To determine if your items can be recycled, visit the Broomfield Recycling Guide . During the 2025 Spring Cleanup, haulers made 9,125 stops throughout Broomfield to pick up waste from Broomfield homes and apartment complexes. A total of 1,014.3 tons of waste were collected, of which 73.85 tons of wood were recycled and 18.09 tons of metal. 2026 Program Details See below for an interactive map or check out this printable general map to determine your specific area. See additional details below including a list of items that will be accepted, and examples of items that will not be picked up. All items must be placed on curb by 7 a.m. (do not place items in driveway or block sidewalks). Items placed after 7 a.m. will NOT be picked up. Separate your items into three piles: one for untreated wood and metal to be recycled, one for waste, and one for clothes and reusable items to be donated to ARC Thrift Store. Place the ARC donation items in a clearly marked "ARC" pile in a separate, visible location away from the curb . Wet items will not be picked up. Contact ARC at arcthrift.com if you prefer to have the items picked up on another day. If you have any questions about the event, please contact Susie Guyot, Recycling Coordinator, at 303-438-6329 or sguyot@broomfield.org . Spring Cleanup Interactive Map View an interactive map of all Spring Cleanup areas and dates by clicking the map below. For general instructions, press the "i" button in the upper right-hand corner of the map.
